Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
style(Worker): Revert ESBuild configurations to readable PascalCase format

The ESBuild configuration files in `Configuration/ESBuild/` were inadvertently minified, compressing variable names to single letters (e.g., `i`, `o`, `t`, `e`, `r`, `n`) and collapsing control flow into dense blocks. This contradicts the project's strict PascalCase naming convention for all variables and functions, even in build scripts, and severely hampers readability and maintainability.

Revert `Target.js` and `Configuration/ESBuild/Worker.js` to the expanded, readable format used in the source `Source/Configuration/ESBuild/Worker.js`. Ensure all local variables and exports follow PascalCase (e.g., `On`, `Clean`, `Default`). Restore descriptive destructuring and explicit control flow statements. The source configuration remains the source of truth, ensuring consistency across the Worker element's build pipeline without altering the underlying build logic or output behavior.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
feat(Worker): Integrate development telemetry bridge and format configs

Introduce a dual-pipe telemetry system in the Worker element to capture service-worker lifecycle events (install, activate) and custom spans via PostHog and OTLP. The new Bridge.ts module uses lazy-loading to ensure zero production bundle impact while providing detailed debugging metrics in development.

Align the ESBuild configuration files (Target.js, Worker.js) with the project's formatting standards, expanding compressed syntax into a readable, multi-line structure without altering build logic. Update the CHANGELOG to reflect the current version history and architectural decisions for the workbench lift cycle.

This establishes the foundation for observability in the background processing layer while maintaining strict separation between debug instrumentation and runtime performance.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
docs(Worker): Expand CHANGELOG with comprehensive version history

Rewrote the CHANGELOG from 61 to 134 lines, organizing it into clear version sections (v2.1, v2.0, v1.x, v1.0, v0.0) with detailed commit references, dates, and narrative descriptions of each major milestone.

The new format documents the complete Worker history—from the April 2025 project inception (v0.0), through the pivotal May 2025 web-worker implementation (v1.0), Q1 2026 editor launch sprint (v2.0), to the April 2026 full workbench lift (v2.1). Each section now includes Added, Changed, and Fixed subsections with specific commit hashes, making it easier to trace the evolution of our service-worker and web-worker layers for Wind/Sky.
